The '''Rock wart egg''', as implied, was the [[Egg/Legends|egg]] of the [[Rock wart/Legends|rock wart]], which lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Avik Lore]] was once contracted to deliver a shipment of rock wart eggs to [[Siskeen/Legends|Siskeen]].
